name: Xuất hồn kích
desc: spirit flames are born at the caster's chest, swell and fan out; six spirits of three sizes (the big one a white-hot comet, the small ones flat-shaded teardrops) each take their own path and strike the target one after another, every hit a different organic spark (a chevron on the torso, a hollow ring at the back of the head, a star flat on the floor, the climax on the head, a fountain out of the ghost); a spiky crater ring races out on the floor and soul flames stand at the feet, cooling to violet, while a ghost runs down the target and drains out. The target stands 340 px ahead of the anchor on the ground (+62 px); the ghost is drawn on a generic head-and-body mask
